evidence.snippet: We introduce Chess-World-Model, a large-scale state-tracking benchmark built from 10 million real chess games, where models predict the exact board state reached after a sequence of legal moves.

claire_radar.motivation: World models require state tracking, which is the ability to maintain a correct latent state across action sequences.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: State tracking is under-tested in realistic domains. This benchmark exposes limitations in Transformer and RNN models that scale alone may hide, offering a practical testbed for world models.
